{{Short description|German mathematician}}
{{expand German|topic=bio|date=February 2022|Jörg Bewersdorff}}
[[File:Jörg Bewersdorff.jpg|thumb|upright|Bewersdorff in 2006]]
'''Jörg Bewersdorff''' (born 1 February 1958 in [[Neuwied]])<ref name="gb">{{cite journal |title=Jörg Bewersdorff|journal=Games & Business|year=2003|issue=6|page=74|issn=1619-0564}}</ref> is a German mathematician who is working as mathematics writer and [[game designer]].<ref name="dmv">{{cite journal|url=http://www.bewersdorff-online.de/dmv0398.htm|title=Berufsbild: Spieldesigner|journal=Mitteilungen der Deutschen Mathematiker-Vereinigung|last=Bewersdorff|first=Jörg|year=1998|volume=6|issue=3|pages=60–61|accessdate=2012-10-04|doi=10.1515/dmvm-1998-0318|s2cid=201729150|doi-access=free|url-access=subscription}}</ref><ref>{{citation |url=https://www.gauselmann.de/Downloads/Business-Report-2014.pdf#page=58|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20160513060537/https://www.gauselmann.de/Downloads/Business-Report-2014.pdf|
pages=56–59|archivedate=2016-05-13|title=Games makers worldwide. The business year for the Gauselmann Group 2014|accessdate=2018-06-14}}</ref>

==Life and work==
After obtaining his ''[[Abitur]]'' from the Werner-Heisenberg-Gymnasium in Neuwied<ref>{{citation |url=http://www.whgneuwied.de/index.php/gemeinschaft/klassen-eltern-und-ehemalige/whg-alumni|title=Werner-Heisenberg-Gymnasium. Alumni|accessdate=2018-06-14|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180828192123/http://www.whgneuwied.de/index.php/gemeinschaft/klassen-eltern-und-ehemalige/whg-alumni|archive-date=2018-08-28}}</ref> Bewersdorff studied mathematics from 1975 to 1982 at the [[University of Bonn]].<ref name="mm">{{citation|last1=Hirsch|first1=Ulrich|last2=Dueck|first2=Gunter|title=Management by Mathematics|year=2003|page=83|isbn=3528031875|doi=10.1007/978-3-322-90788-2_10}}</ref> In 1982 he submitted his diploma in mathematics in Bonn<ref name="mm" /> and in 1985 he received his doctorate there under the supervision of [[Günter Harder]]<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=53699 |title=Jörg Bewersdorff}}</ref> (''A [[Lefschetz fixed-point theorem|Lefschetz fixed point formula]] for [[Hecke operators]]'').<ref>[http://www.zentralblatt-math.org/zbmath/search/?q=an%3A0589.12013 Review in Zentralblatt MATH]</ref>

In 1985 Bewersdorff started a career as game designer.<ref name="gb" /> Since 1998<ref name="mm" /> he is general manager of subsidiaries of the [[Gauselmann|Gauselmann AG]].<ref name="gb" /><ref>{{citation |url=http://www.mega-spiel.de/index.php?Archiv:Kurze_Firmengeschichte|title=Mega-Spielgeräte, Kurze Firmengeschichte|accessdate=2016-04-06}}</ref><ref>{{citation |url= https://www.gewete.com/index.php?Impressum |title=GeWeTe, Impressum|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161116192402/https://www.gewete.com/index.php?Impressum |accessdate=2016-11-16|archive-date=2016-11-16 }}</ref> Bewersdorff is author of four textbooks dealing with [[probability theory]], [[mathematics of gambling]], [[game theory]], [[combinatorial game theory]], [[Galois theory]], [[mathematical statistics]], [[JavaScript]] and [[object-oriented programming]]. Two of them were translated into English. One book was translated also to Korean.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nl.go.kr/nl/search/SearchDetail.nl?category_code=ct&service=KOLIS&vdkvgwkey=250614807&colltype=DAN_HOLD&place_code_info=143&place_name_info=%EC%9E%90%EC%97%B0%EA%B3%BC%ED%95%99%EC%8B%A4(4%EC%B8%B5)&manage_code=MA&shape_code=B&refLoc=null&category=dan&srchFlag=Y&h_kwd=&lic_yn=N&mat_code=GM
|title=Catalog of National Library of Korea|accessdate=2017-04-17|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20180303225201/http://www.nl.go.kr/nl/search/SearchDetail.nl?category_code=ct&service=KOLIS&vdkvgwkey=250614807&colltype=DAN_HOLD&place_code_info=143&place_name_info=%EC%9E%90%EC%97%B0%EA%B3%BC%ED%95%99%EC%8B%A4(4%EC%B8%B5)&manage_code=MA&shape_code=B&refLoc=null&category=dan&srchFlag=Y&h_kwd=&lic_yn=N&mat_code=GM|archivedate=2018-03-03}}</ref> Bewersdorff's books are undergraduate level books. Their goal is to explain applications and what is going on behind the formalism.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.bezreg-duesseldorf.nrw.de/lerntreffs/mathe/pages/magazin/leute/bewersdorfaffe.php|title=Jörg Bewersdorff und die Algebra|accessdate=2012-10-04 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170107204308/http://www.bezreg-duesseldorf.nrw.de/lerntreffs/mathe/pages/magazin/leute/bewersdorfaffe.php |archive-date=2017-01-07}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|author=Chris Linton|title=Editorial|journal=Mathematics Today|year=2012|volume=48|issue=6|pages=242–243|url=http://www.ima.org.uk/_db/_documents/mt_dec12_editorial.pdf|issn=1361-2042|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20130329094459/http://www.ima.org.uk/_db/_documents/mt_dec12_editorial.pdf|archivedate=2013-03-29}}</ref>
